Title: How to Redownload Deleted Nintendo Switch Games & Apps (Fast Method!)
IntroLines: Deleted a game on your Nintendo Switch and need to get it back fast?
In this video, I'll show you the fastest way to redownload your deleted games and apps in seconds.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: REDOWNLOAD VIA VIRTUAL GAME CARDS (FAST METHOD)
Steps: •  First, turn on your Nintendo Switch and make sure you are connected to the internet.
•  From your HOME Menu, navigate to and select the " Virtual Game Cards " option.
•  Choose the user profile that originally purchased or downloaded the game.
•  Scroll through your library and locate the deleted game or app in the list.
•  Choose " Load on this system " from the options.
•  Wait a few moments while your Switch loads and installs the game files.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and verify that the game is ready to play.
Sections.Bridge: If you can't find your game card here, you can also redownload it directly through the Nintendo eShop.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: REDOWNLOAD FROM THE NINTENDO ESHOP
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open the " Nintendo eShop " orange bag icon.
•  Select the user profile linked to your purchase.
•  Move up and select your " Profile Icon " in the top-right corner of the screen.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Redownload " .
•  Find your deleted game or app from the list of purchased titles.
•  Select the orange " Download Cloud " icon next to the game name.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and confirm the download progress bar has started.

OutroLines: And that's how you can easily redownload deleted games and apps on your Nintendo Switch.
